study.question: Does the observed click-quality cost of auxiliary-head channel removal depend on auxiliary gradients into shared context, and can blocking that path make reduced capacity useful under the frozen quality/cost protocol?
study.hypothesis: Observed: auxiliary-only reduction (128->112 first-layer channels per auxiliary tower) lowered click AUC from0.6671410169523699 to0.6657436780708307, although the click head, common initialization and item/scorer gradient blocks were preserved. Source inspection finds auxiliary context enters both its residual adapter and its tower, with attached gradients into shared embedding tables. Hypothesis: at least part of the apparent capacity sensitivity is indirect auxiliary supervision of context. Removing that supervision may attenuate the click penalty of auxiliary-head reduction. This is unverified; global dense clipping remains a cross-task path. The round36 reduction also failed to lower observed end-to-end prediction time (28.3223 versus26.0211 seconds), so this follow-up is primarily discriminating attribution and only conditionally an efficiency candidate.

nearest_work.difference: Direct inherited implementation: full-parent initialization, physical channel removal and Dice-state slicing. The new factor enables the already implemented context stop-gradient at both auxiliary consumers. No new attention, token mixing, learned gate or loss weighting.

This experiment concerns auxiliary backward ownership and channel capacity, absent from the inspected DIN mechanism; it is not an exact paper reproduction or a priority claim.

No claim of originality relative to the full original literature is made.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 backward-ownership by auxiliary-capacity factorial. The attached/full and attached/reduced cells are byte-identical registered sources. Two new cells change only CONFIG/default block_aux_context_grad to True and relax the constructor guard to allow that already supported boolean; all forward/helper method ASTs are identical to their respective ancestors. Context values still feed every auxiliary prediction; their auxiliary gradient paths are detached at both residual and tower consumers. Full auxiliary heads remain128/64 or reduce to112/64 via the inherited constructor. All heads and four BCE terms remain trained; this is neither forward feature removal nor a new unified architecture.
predictions: Reproduction: full attached AUC should match0.6671410169523699 and reduced attached0.6657436780708307 under the deterministic frozen seed, within1e-6 numerical tolerance. Larger unexplained mismatch blocks mechanistic interpretation.

At fixed initialization and a fixed legal batch, toggling context stop-gradient at either width should preserve every forward probability, Dice moment update and module state; only gradients differ. Host must test this in train/eval modes without updating weights.

An auxiliary-only loss should produce no gradient into shared embeddings/scorer in the blocked cells, while gradients into auxiliary towers/residual banks survive; click-only gradients into context remain. Inspect actual embedding sharing before assigning field-specific ownership. Check empty, partial, all-masked and altered-padding batches, including missing/special match IDs.

Mechanism screen: interaction I=(A11-A01)-(A10-A00)>=0.0005 and blocked capacity effect |A11-A01|<=0.0002. Report both main effects even if this screen fails. Repetitions are needed for support beyond this seed.

Freeze primary preservation before execution: a utility candidate must have click AUC>=0.6669410169523699 (incumbent0.6671410169523699 minus0.0002), and delta versus the contemporaneous full attached bridge>=-0.0002. This is also stricter than the imported entry floor0.666553547526167. Treat these as practical screens, not significance claims.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values, auxiliary mean AUC separately, primary Logloss, declared history slices with sample/positive/negative counts, and missing uncertainty estimates explicitly. Guard against trading away the multi-task output: auxiliary mean AUC decline>0.002 or any task Logloss increase>0.001 versus contemporaneous full reference prevents an unqualified joint-model recommendation.

Parameter prediction from registered receipts: full32108245 total/315029 dense; reduced32085877 total/292661 dense; embedding31793216 unchanged. Reduction22368 parameters (7.10% dense,0.0697% total). No reduction is caused by detach alone. Host must measure actual counts/storage.

Prediction-cost gate: at the same host batch8192 and measurement path, require at least2% lower median model-only p50 batch latency, p95 no more than2% worse, and at least2% lower median full-validation inference seconds versus contemporaneous full attached control. Confirm with at least3 authorized paired timing measurements if the initial screen passes; charge all of them. Also compare reduced blocked to full blocked to isolate width-related cost. Report throughput, train/wall/GPU time, examples and peak memory. Small parameter/FLOP savings alone do not satisfy the task.
falsifiers: A reproducible AUC loss beyond the frozen0.0002 tolerance or failure of measured prediction-cost improvement rejects candidate utility, regardless of an attractive mechanism interaction.
A nonpositive interaction or continuing blocked-context capacity penalty greater than0.0002 fails this proposed pathway-dependent rescue; it does not prove all auxiliary capacity necessary.
If detached full/reduced gains are equal, the evidence favors a context-gradient main effect rather than capacity-dependent mediation.

Changed forward values, failed mask/padding invariance, nonfinite/backward failures, leaked auxiliary gradients into shared embeddings/scorer, altered inherited RNG/initialization or optimizer exposure invalidate the intended contrast; retain charged failures and diagnose before interpretation.

If global clipping or undeclared shared parameters explain differences after context blocking, do not assert context as the exclusive mediator. Do not change the host clipping contract to force isolation.
alternative_explanations: Global dense gradient clipping couples independent task heads through a shared norm even when context gradients are blocked; do not infer exclusive context mediation from AUC alone.
The channel-sliced subnet retains full-parent Xavier scaling; this round holds it fixed and does not test native reduced-shape initialization.
Single-seed training and runtime variability; same-seed bridge repetitions are reproducibility/cost checks, not independent seed support.
All auxiliary tasks change together; the design identifies aggregate auxiliary-context dependence, not which auxiliary label or context field is responsible.

The initial missing torch/data environment is an execution limitation, distinct from the successful host validation evidence and from scientific counterevidence. No new training or numerical result is claimed in this proposal.

Sparse task prevalence and label semantics may cause auxiliary quality shifts unrelated to useful click information. The auxiliary labels remain24h user/category/brand matches, not advertisement conversion attribution.

Trajectory review: embedding12 (AUC0.6641112), scorer-half (0.6654369), tower-half (0.6654569) and shared projection reuse (0.6648249) all lost quality; the latter also changed initialization/representation and cannot be treated as pure reuse evidence. Residual allocation click14/aux10 reached0.6671249; evaluation factoring then reached0.6671410, while combined batching preserved quality but cost28 seconds. These positive/null/negative trajectories motivate keeping representations intact and isolating the newly observed backward dependence rather than claiming size alone predicts quality.

Repeated identical seed results in the imported history establish deterministic reproduction only. Paired user-cluster uncertainty is authorized only if the host exposes legal validation predictions; do not invent sample identities, bootstrap intervals or unavailable timestamps. No withheld outcome is available.
